recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-17970 unless a later work group decision changes financial resource Patient compartment policy.
issue_request: FHIR-17970 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core FM change request for FHIR-core-EligibilityResponse, raised and applied for STU3, asking to add Patient to Compartments.
initial_application: The 2018-11-04 GF#17970 batch commit f369c813fb40cd39c0db46336b2b3186f496fb47 touched the financial resource area but did not yet add the Patient cell. The next explicit application commit, afb5ec66f68641293bb7950b6e0eeb118fa1444a, included '17970: Add CoverageEligibilityResponse to Patient compartment' and added patient to the CoverageEligibilityResponse row in source/compartments.xml.
additional_context: Current FHIR source uses CoverageEligibilityResponse as the successor to EligibilityResponse. source/fhir.ini has active entries for coverageeligibilityresponse and CompartmentDefinition and maps CoverageEligibilityResponse back to EligibilityResponse for rename history. CoverageEligibilityResponse.patient is a required Reference(Patient), the patient search parameter exists, and later FHIR-39386 Patient compartment cleanup preserved the row. Zulip and Confluence searches found no contrary evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because source/compartments.xml already lists CoverageEligibilityResponse under the Patient compartment via patient, matching the issue request.

related_jiras.note: Later Published compartment cleanup for missing patient/subject resources preserved the CoverageEligibilityResponse patient membership.
